correctness.rationale: Every order-preserving crown map is 1-Lipschitz in the undirected graph metric. Unit-step lifts force d in {-1,0,1}; zero degree yields an invariant arc of at most N edges. Periodic-set isometry forces a fixed interval or an endpoint-swap reflection interval; parity forces a single midpoint fixed point, with 2b<=N. Extremal degrees force exact even rotations/reflections. Explicit parity-compatible maps attain every listed spectrum; zeta products follow algebraically. Direct exhaustive checker corroborates N=2,3,4 without being substituted for proof.

value.rationale: A complete all-size dynamical classification is a natural invariant of finite topological-circle dynamics, resolving which temporal periods and entire zeta functions are possible. The sharp nonbijective two-cycle upper bound versus reflection \(N-1\) (strict for \(N\ge3\)) makes a structural constraint invisible to map counts, homotopy degree and graph image-rank data. The witnesses are explicit and the result identifies a genuine qualitative boundary between collapsing and invertible dynamics.
